messages:
maria.p: Heads-up — next week's RBAC cutover for SIEM exports is going live Wed 09:00 UTC. Quick questions: what retention windows will actually be applied to exported raw events vs scrubbed/aggregated copies? Also how will KMS-wrapped export tokens be rotated?

alex.g: Short answer: raw events -> 90d, scrubbed/aggregates -> 365d by default. But we need policy exceptions for legal/forensics holds. KMS rotation handled by infra team via monthly key versioning + automatic rewrap job.

sam.k: Where did the 90/365 defaults come from? Any objection from legal/compliance?

maria.p: Policy drafted from last QBR + bench with SOC. Legal approved 90/365 as default but asked for explicit exception process and audit trail.

julie.r: For the cutover, we need to ensure existing exported S3 paths get a lifecycle applied. infra-sre, can you confirm we can apply an object-level tag -> lifecycle rule mapping?

infra-sre: Yep, lifecycle via tag: "siem_tier:raw" -> 90d expire, "siem_tier:masked" -> 365d. We'll run a migration job to tag current objects. Planning job Tue night.

alex.g: Two KMS notes: (1) exports are encrypted with customer-managed key (CMK) in the export pipeline, then wrapped with a short-lived export token for downstream consumers. (2) Rotation flow: create new key version, update pipeline to encrypt with new key, rewrap existing tokens via rewrap job for any tokens still valid. Old wrapped artifacts remain unreadable after key deletion.

maria.p: For JIT analyst access to raw logs during vuln triage/IR, what's the approved flow? We don't want analysts poking at raw PII unnecessarily.

sam.k: Current flow: submit a JIRA with justification tag "siem:jitauthorize" -> security approves -> infra triggers ephemeral snapshot (TTL 24h) and KMS unwrap delegated to analyst service account with restricted role. We should document the exact privilege boundaries.

julie.r: Can we tighten that to MFA plus step-up approval for >48h requests? Also require scrub template run before snapshot if requester is not on forensics rota.

infra-sre: We can enforce step-up approval via the approval lambda. MFA is already enforced for the analyst role, but will add explicit step-up check based on duration.

oncall-bot: Incident note: last incident (3951234000) required JIT access twice. Reminder: include the incident ID in the JIRA for traceability.

maria.p: Good. Now operational questions about SIEM export consumers (partners). How are we gating external partner pulls? We need to avoid long-lived tokens in partner systems.

alex.g: Partners receive short-lived AWS STS creds to a pre-signed download endpoint. We rotate STS role trust every 7 days and issue tokens with max 1h lifespan. For longer access, partners must implement our replay API which enforces RBAC and logging.

sam.k: Do we log partner downloads in audit? Need to make sure export events are ingested into the audit log with KMS key ID + consumer role for compliance.

infra-sre: Yes — every export download writes an immutable audit event to the audit-topic with fields: event_type=export_download, object_path, consumer_principal, kms_key_id, request_ts. Those events are retained 3 years.

maria.p: That retention mismatch (3y for audit, 90/365 for data) is intentional, right?

julie.r: Yes, audit trail must be longer for evidence. But we should flag the data/audit sync in docs so reviewers don't get confused.

sam.k: Anything pending for the cutover? I can own a checklist.

maria.p: Action items: (1) infra-sre to publish migration runbook + tagging job (due Tue EOD). (2) alex.g to publish KMS rotation playbook and rewrap tool (due Mon). (3) sam.k to create a one-click JIT template + doc for analysts (due Wed morning). (4) julie.r to update policy exceptions workflow and legal contact list.

infra-sre: Ack, starting migration plan. Will post status in #eng-ops.

alex.g: Will push KMS doc to confluence and link from infra runbook.

sam.k: I'll draft the JIT template and PM the SOC leads for acceptance.

julie.r: I'll update the exception repo and ping legal.

maria.p: Thanks all. If anything looks risky for the Wednesday roll, call it out here or escalate to oncall.

oncall-bot: Deployment window reminder: RBAC cutover deploy scheduled Wed 09:00-10:30 UTC. Pager escalation enabled.
